design_detail: Wealth tax in the alliance's input into the 2022 national budget
quote_original: The 2022 national budget must introduce wealth tax to bridge the gap between the rich and the poor through ensuring that those with more are taxed more.
source_title: Zimbabweans lobby groups advocate for wealth tax
grading_note: The alliance's budget submission, quoted by the news site, names a wealth tax without a rate or threshold.

design_detail: Wealth tax on the super rich to finance health care, ahead of the 2026 budget

design_detail: Annual wealth tax on the richest person: 5% on wealth over US$1 billion (US$65 million a year); 10% (US$130 million) in a more progressive version
quote_original: An annual wealth tax on the wealthiest individual in Zimbabwe would raise US$65 million a year (with rates at 5% on wealth over US$1 billion).
grading_note: Oxfam's report as quoted by The NewsHawks (29 January 2022); the original report was not opened. It prices a wealth tax with a rate and threshold as part of Oxfam's global call, so B; month from the article date.
